# Context Intelligence Requirements Checklist: Context Intelligence Lift

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of slice retrieval, model-aware packing, working vs durable memory, cheaper-model paired lift, and fail-closed safety. Not an implementation test plan.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. Intended for the author before `/speckit-tasks` and for peers on spec/PR review.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are slice-based retrieval of docs, code, and durable memory all required, with whole-repository dump forbidden? [Completeness, Spec §US1, FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is auto-discovery specified for categories with a deterministic default location, and omission-with-reason required when retrieval fails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are typed pack slots specified (goal, policy, docs, code, memory) rather than a chat-history dump? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is the cheaper-identity paired evaluation specified as unaided then packed on the same concrete identity? [Completeness, Spec §US3, FR-018]
- [x] CHK005 Are lift / no-lift / blocked conclusion classes defined so fixture stubs cannot be reported as lift? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, FR-020]
- [x] CHK006 Are working state and durable memory specified as distinct, with gated ingest and no automatic archive of working slots? [Completeness, Spec §US4, FR-013]
- [x] CHK007 Are pack/receipt secret and transcript exclusions specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, FR-014]
- [x] CHK008 Is optional compaction explicitly not required for Stories 1–3, with required fact/policy retention if used? [Completeness, Spec §US5, FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is the named-check artifact specified as exact JSON `{"lift_fact":"<planted token>"}` with an independent checker? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001a]
- [x] CHK010 Is “cheaper identity” defined as a live-routing local/free/cheaper concrete identity, not a paid stand-in? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 Is “blocked” versus “passed” defined so an unreachable live surface cannot be reported as lift? [Clarity, Spec §US3 AC4, FR-020]
- [x] CHK012 Is fail-closed compile specified when policy or the unique required fact cannot fit the budget? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK013 Is slice planning specified as Core-owned and deterministic, with optional stronger-identity proposals still bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is the planted token forbidden from the unaided task wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001a, FR-001b]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do US3 / FR-018 / FR-019 / SC-004 / SC-005 agree that lift requires unaided fail and packed success on the same live identity? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK016 Is “Core owns policy; adapters never admit/exclude” consistent across US1, FR-005, and assumptions? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK017 Does “no vendor memory required” stay consistent with optional adapters and local-archive sufficiency? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK018 Is Feature 276 cheaper-first reused rather than redefined, without weakening catalog/probe rules? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, FR-017]
- [x] CHK019 Are working-state slots and durable ingest non-overlapping in US4 and FR-013? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK020 Can SC-001 (planted fact retrieved; ≥90% of files in a 20+ file repo excluded) be measured without source access? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK021 Can SC-002 (100% of packs within budget; 100% of omissions reasoned) be measured from the pack receipt? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK022 Can SC-003 (non-developer names included source, omission, and required-fact kept) be scored from the receipt in under 5 minutes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK023 Can SC-004 require a live cheaper identity and an inspectable lift or no-lift conclusion, not a fixture pass? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Can SC-005 fail any lift claim from fixture stubs or swapped identities? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK025 Can SC-006 be failed by a secrets/transcript negative suite on packs and receipts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK026 Can SC-007 determinism be checked on pack digest and conclusion class for the same inputs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are primary-flow requirements complete for plan slices → retrieve → compile → cheaper identity → unaided/packed named check → receipt? [Coverage, Spec §US1–US3]
- [x] CHK028 Are exception-flow requirements defined for empty retrieval, unknown context limit, no cheaper identity, and compile refuse? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Is the unreachable-live-surface scenario specified as blocked rather than as an alternate success path? [Coverage, Spec §US3 AC4]
- [x] CHK030 Are dual-use fixtures specified so compile-rule tests cannot be labeled as the live lift demonstration? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK031 Is a planner/slice that would dump the repository required to be refused? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-001]
- [x] CHK032 Are contradictory units for the same slot key required to be recorded rather than silently merged? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK033 Is a packed attempt on a different identity than unaided specified as an invalid pair? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is unaided transport failure specified as blocked/operational, not no-lift quality? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK035 Is stale durable memory marked stale and not treated as fresh evidence? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional & Safety

- [x] CHK036 Are secrets, credentials, prompts, completions, and raw tool arguments forbidden on packs and receipts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK037 Is gated ingest required to refuse secrets/transcripts and persist the refusal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK038 Are latency/scale NFRs intentionally deferred to a single paired check rather than leaking unstated demo expectations? [Gap, plan.md Performance Goals]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK039 Is Feature 276 live cheaper-first documented as a dependency, not as optional degraded mode? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md]
- [x] CHK040 Is reuse of pack compiler, memory plane/gate, docs inventory, and code graph stated rather than implying a parallel stack? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, research.md R2]
- [x] CHK041 Are Vertex/ADK and other vendor memory/graph runtimes explicitly not required? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK042 Does any remaining “optional adapter” sentence contradict live-proof-required? [Conflict, Spec §FR-015 vs FR-020]
- [x] CHK043 Is the named checker’s exact artifact plan-level only, or bound in the spec so implement cannot treat “any JSON” as the check? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001a]
